solar_setup.title: Solar charging setup
solar_setup.description: Keep shadow mode on while mapping and observing your sensors. Exported grid power and battery discharge must be negative. Live control also needs a home sensor and a physical stop test. Complete vehicle mappings before enabling the controller.

solar_vehicles.title: Vehicles and physical control
solar_vehicles.description: Wall Connector measurements cannot start or stop charging. Select the actual vehicle control switch and home sensor or device tracker on the same vehicle device as its connection and battery entities. Generic EVSE switches are not supported. Gen 2 Rivian remote control is not supported by the upstream paired-control implementation. A schedule API probe alone does not prove physical control. Acknowledge a supported Rivian control here, then pause automation and run the physical stop test from the Solar charging page. That test stops an actively charging vehicle and does not restart it.

data.rivian_control_confirmed: I have verified this control can start and stop the Rivian

solar_forecast.title: Forecast and battery planning
solar_forecast.description: Map energy sensors from Forecast.Solar, Solcast, or another existing integration (Wh or kWh), plus the integration's source-update timestamp. Forecasts can advise, or protect battery and household reserves before new sessions. Live measured surplus always determines current. Forecast protection requires both forecasts, a fresh source timestamp, and the usable house battery capacity.

data.forecast_next_hour_entity: Solar energy forecast for the next hour
data.battery_target_soc: House battery target for forecast reservation

solar_tuning.title: Cloud response and limits
solar_tuning.description: Current falls promptly when power drops. Smoothing applies to increases. Brief deficits have both a time and energy limit; the hard limits stop immediately. Select only blocker helpers you actually use. An unavailable selected blocker prevents charging.

data.max_transient_deficit_wh: Maximum energy allowed during a brief cloud
data.hard_grid_import_w: Grid import that stops charging immediately
data.hard_battery_discharge_w: Battery discharge that stops charging immediately
data.feedback_timeout_seconds: Maximum wait for physical charging feedback
